paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.74% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.42%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.86%). Brent crude changed -7.33% to 109.02. Gold changed +0.27% to 3,909.5. Bitcoin changed -0.62% to 77,765.3125. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.929%, a relative move of -1.20%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (-6.16%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-5.55%) moved the most.
